'''Tret Zanway''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was present on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the [[King's Pass]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].
